mcp.add.badEnvName: "{{name}}" isn't an environment variable name: use letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit.
mcp.add.badUrl: Enter the server's full URL, starting with https://.
mcp.add.envNeedsStdio: Environment variables go to a server the CLI starts (stdio). An HTTP or SSE server takes headers instead.
mcp.add.headerNeedsReference: The {{name}} header's value must refer to an environment variable, e.g. Bearer ${MY_TOKEN}, so the key itself never passes through AgentChainer. To set a plain value, add the server in your terminal.
mcp.add.headersNeedUrl: Headers go to an HTTP or SSE server. A server the CLI starts (stdio) takes environment variables instead.
mcp.add.httpsOnly: Use https://. Plain http:// is only allowed to this computer (localhost).
mcp.add.noCommand: Enter the command that starts the server.
mcp.add.secretInCommand: The command looks like it holds a key or token. Pass it as an environment variable instead: add its name below and set it in your environment.
mcp.add.secretInUrl: The URL looks like it holds a key, token or password. Send it in a header that refers to an environment variable instead.
mcp.add.title: Add MCP server {{name}}
mcp.add.unclosedQuote: A quote in the command isn't closed.
mcp.get.unreadable: The CLI's details for {{name}} couldn't be read. Run `claude mcp get {{name}}` in a terminal to see them.
